description: This file defines the AxisMapper class responsible for mapping chart axis properties from a Document Object Model (DOM) representation to a rendering model in the MigraDoc library, including styling, gridlines, tick marks, and scale settings.

classes.name: AxisMapper
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping axis properties from DOM to rendering model in chart rendering.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps properties from a DOM axis object to a rendering axis object, including styles, tick marks, gridlines, title, and scale.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method to create an AxisMapper instance and map properties from DOM axis to rendering axis.
